description: Read a section from a guide file (markdown, YAML, examples). Supports pagination via offset, or a "#heading-slug" anchor to jump straight to a section (as returned by search_guide()). Use after search_guide() to fetch the full content at a specific location.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based, default 1). Ignored when path has a "#" anchor.

path.description: Relative path from repo root, optionally with a "#heading-slug" anchor (e.g. "guide/ultimate-guide.md", "guide/core/memory-systems.md#1-tldr-three-track-model")

name: read_section
